full_judgment:
Mr. A. M. Mahmudur Rahman, J:- This Petition for Leave to Appeal by added defendant-petitioners is from the judgment and order dated 21.5.1998 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4289 of 1991 making the Rule Nisi absolute setting aside the judgment and decree passed by the lower appellate court in Title Appeal No. 163 of 1986 and affirming those of the learned Assistant Judge dated 3.9.1986 passed in Title Suit No. 302 of 1976 decreeing the suit. 

 4. The trial court on consideration of evidence on record decreed the suit against that decree defendant No. 3 preferred Title Appeal No. 163 of 1986 before the learned District. Judge which was allowed on contest and the judgment and decree of the trial court was set aside and the suit was dismissed. The plaintiff moved the High Court Division in Revision and obtained a Rule. The Rule was contested by the defendant No. 2 and 3.
